Endless Access | Engineering Lead | Hybrid NYC | full time | 150k-250k

We're a mission-oriented org focused on bridging the global digital divide. Key to our strategy is our community game-making program: guiding learners to move from playing games to creating them. We're hiring a tech lead for our learner community platform.

Stack: Node.js, Nuxt/Vue, Apollo, GraphQL. 8+ years experience; open-source/community/edtech background desirable.

https://endlessaccess.bamboohr.com/careers/33

This is a true tech lead job: making calls about implementation, holding the standard, owning the shared delivery plan. You'll partner with a product lead on strategy, and with an engineering manager for roadmapping & delivery. You will also work hands-on in the codebase. We're a small team (about 40) and everyone is hands-on.

There's a unique org structure at play here: Endless is a multi-pronged organization, and two of them share the platform. So the role has one foot in each organization - the hiring entity is Endless Studios, and most of the engineers work at Endless Access. You'll collaborate with passionate, brilliant people on both sides of the house.

I don't refer; apply directly at the link above. All applications are reviewed by a human.
